lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"That armor we wear[01]to protect us from[02]the hex is really[01]heavy![02]Walking around in it[01]all day makes you[01]real hungry!"

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"Uhhh...I don't feel[01]so good...[02]Maybe the hex got[01]to me..."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Uhhh...Nao estou me sentindo bem nao... [02]Acho que a maldição chegou em mim..."

lines.text_source: [14][03][03]"See that fellow[01]standing there, in[01]front of the pot?[02]That's our boss,[01]Tahb."

lines.base_translation: [14][03][03]"Ve aquele cara ali em pe, na [01]frente da panela? [02]Esse é nosso chefe, Tahb."

lines.text_source: [14][04][04]"Way I figure it, the[01]hex is like someone[01]talking bad about you.[02]I mean, when someone[01]says something bad,[02]you don't feel too[01]good, right?[02]So a hex is like[01]that, except lots[01]more powerful, see?"

lines.base_translation: [14][04][04]"Eu acho que a maldição é tipo alguem [01]falando mal de voce. [02]Tipo, quando alguem diz algo ruim, voce nao se sente bem, certo? [02]Entao uma maldição é tipo isso, mas muito mais poderosa, ve?"
lines.risk_notes: Explained game mechanic; must preserve analogy clarity for player understanding

lines.text_source: [14][05][05]"The hex the Empire[01]makes is like this[01]black mist...[02]And there's all sorts[01]of nasty stuff like[02]wraiths and specters[01]inside of it...[02]Even the smallest[01]exposure to it[02]without protection[01]is lethal!"

lines.base_translation: [14][05][05]"A maldição que o Imperio faz é tipo uma [01]neblina preta... [02]E tem todo tipo de coisa ruim tipo [02]aparições e espectros dentro dela... [02]Ate a menor exposição sem protecao [01]é mortal!"
lines.risk_notes: Critical safety warning; must convey absolute lethality without melodrama; preserve enumeration of threats (wraiths/specters)

lines.text_source: [14][06][06]"This ain't a[01]place for women[01]and children...[02]Don't you know it's[01]been hexed!?

lines.base_translation: [14][06][06]"Esse nao é um lugar para mulheres [01]e crianças... [02]Voces nao sabem que foi amaldiçoado!?"

lines.text_source: [0C][04][14][C1]@"We need to get[01]through Chamba.[02]Is there any way we[01]can do that before[01]the hex disappears?"

lines.base_translation: [0C][04][14][C1]@"Precisamos atravessar Chamba. [02]Tem alguma forma de fazermos isso antes [01]que a maldição desapareça?"

lines.text_source: [14][05][05]"Well, there are some[01]places where the hex[02]is getting thin and[01]wearing off...[02]Nah, forget it--it's[01]too dangerous!"

lines.text_source: [14][06][06]"You want me to take[01]you through the hex?[02]Humph! You don't know[01]it like I do...[02]If you did, you'd[01]know better than to[01]even ask."

lines.text_source: [14][07][07]"Everyone is all out[01]working.[02][19]
lines.speaker: npc
